cmd: echo '=== snap data ==='; sudo ls /var/snap/oracle-cloud-agent/ 2>&1; echo '=== plugin log files ==='; sudo find /var/log /var/snap -iname '*runcommand*' 2>/dev/null | head; echo '=== plugin net ==='; sudo ss -tunap 2>/dev/null | grep -i runcommand | head -8; echo '=== all ocarun conns ==='; sudo ss -tunap 2>/dev/null | grep ocarun | awk '{print $5}' | sort -u | head -10
note: شبكة وسجلات مكوّن runcommand — قراءة فقط.
